notes.title: The 9th update of Fetish Locator: S&M Studio is live on Patreon!
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Hey, friends![/i][/b][/p][p]Since the point when you and Stacy left everything behind to chase your dreams and conquer the world of adult cinema, it’s all been leading to this. This is the moment in the adventure where fantasies become reality, and ideas take form on screen.
[/p][p]In the [b][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/135260237"]ninth release of S&M Studio[/url],[/b] you’ll shoot your very first [b]feature-length film[/b] in your own studio—complete with models, sets, and a script that you and your team brought to life together.[/p][p]This is far more than just a technical leap forward. It’s a creative milestone, packed with passion, challenges, and ambition. And with so many juicy behind-the-scenes events, you’ll get to see familiar characters in entirely new ways.
[/p][p]Working with Stacy, Kanya, and Taisia, you’ll go through every step of production: writing the script, building the sets, designing costumes, and finally shooting your masterpiece. This storyline of making a movie is the heart of the 9th release—and trust us, you won’t want to miss a second of it.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/ca4fd2b21f66fc5c9745c5d6583f03bc2257aff5.png"][/img][/p][p]But the action doesn’t stop on the set. A sudden [b]cyberattack[/b] hits the IT department’s servers—and now the whole team is counting on you and your brilliant tech experts, April and Nari.[/p][p]You’ll need to act fast and work as one to stop the threat and save the project. And after that kind of stress, there’s only one thing left to do… help the girls unwind.
[/p][p]Let’s start with [b]Claire[/b]. A closed-door office meeting with her quickly turns into something far more personal. Just be sure to be mindful that in the office, you never know who else is watching.
[/p][p]If you've stuck around through [b]April's [/b]stubbornness, you'll now get to see a new side of her as she tries to balance her work at Orbix and her responsibilities to her bandmates. The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/2a2b910dd0957e27dc5e5da5a32655cd1b0db907.png"][/img][/p][p]For fans of [b]Lyssa[/b], we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful [b]date at the amusement park[/b] with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a [b]sizzling[/b] [b]photoshoot[/b] with the sexiest lawyer you know.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/563690fc8390de0602ee4156e162e15f4528e2e7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]💥 Here’s what’s waiting for you in this release:[/b][/p][p]
 — [b]25 new scenes
[/b] — [b]3718 new renders
[/b] — [b]251 animations[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank each and every one of you for your patience, support, and love for this project. You’re the reason we keep pushing ourselves to make each update better than the last.
[/p][p]And just a reminder—[b]S&M Studio now has an official Steam page [/b]so you can wishlist it right not to stay updated.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763690/Fetish_Locator_SM_Studio/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]See you on set! 🎬💋[/b][/p][p]
[/p]
